snippet.title: Trainwatch Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Take on the role of Troy, a newly appointed Gatekeeper tasked with managing a lonely railway crossing for one month. Stationed in a lonely tower in the middle of nowhere, Troy faces a final chance to stay sober, regain his wife's trust, and rebuild a broken life.

Developed and published by Harvester Games.

#TheIndiePremier #GameShowcase #IndieGames #GAME
